title: When chough change ship runs the review, the gate-closed relay does not name the review or its actor
symptom: After a ship that ran specsync change review as the human, the gate-closed entry's relayed_by has decided_by, words, where and recorded_by but no native or actor
trigger: chough change ship <id> --close-gate <review gate> with the relay, with no current scoped review
expected: relayed_by names native and actor when the gate drove a native step (REQ-history-010)
actual: The close is passed only a summary, so native and actor stay unset
environment: local-macos-arm64, tester build at ad44a0d9, debug, real SpecSync 6.3.0
impact: A reader of the Timeline cannot tell a review ran for the gate, or as whom
source: t38b, 6.3.0 re-run, area approvals and gates

notes.text: status: open -> investigating. Red at 5ab111b7 (before its fix, SpecSync 6.3.0 on PATH): TC-cli-a-ship-records-the-review-it-ran failed for this bug's reason; fix in b5453b53.
status: investigating -> verified. Green at 7986e008: TC-cli-a-ship-records-the-review-it-ran passed; change, relay, humans, direct_writes and native tests pass.
